hero.title: Smart parking solutions
hero.subtitle: in Piraeus
hero.description: Licence plate recognition, controlled access, contracts and real-time monitoring. One platform for the whole car park.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Choose MEGA Parking?
whyChooseUs.description: Park next to the port of Piraeus, in a facility that is monitored around the clock.

location.title: Prime Location
location.description: Located near the Port of Piraeus and city center, we're just minutes away from local businesses, attractions, and transportation hubs.

security.title: Secure & Safe
security.description: Our facility is well-lit and monitored with advanced security systems to ensure your vehicle remains safe and secure at all times.

space.title: Spacious Parking
space.description: Wide, comfortable parking spaces designed to accommodate vehicles of all sizes, from compact cars to larger SUVs.

support.title: Customer Support
support.description: Our friendly staff is always available to assist you with any queries or concerns regarding our parking services.

features.title: What the platform does
features.description: Everything a car park needs to run without paperwork and without queues.

lpr.title: Licence plate recognition
lpr.description: Cameras read the plate on the way in and on the way out, and record every movement with a photo and a timestamp.

access.title: Controlled access
access.description: Barriers open by themselves for vehicles with an active contract. Visitors pass through and are charged for their time.

contracts.title: Contracts and subscriptions
contracts.description: Monthly subscriptions, corporate contracts and several vehicles per customer, with validity dates and limits.

dashboard.title: Real-time picture
dashboard.description: Which vehicles are inside, how many spaces are left and what happened in the last hour — on one screen.

erp.title: SoftOne integration
erp.description: Customers, items and documents stay in step with the ERP, with nothing entered twice.

reports.title: Reports and history
reports.description: Movements per day, exits without an entry, and the full recognition history for every plate.

business.title: Business Solutions
business.description: Tailored parking solutions for businesses and organizations.

testimonials.title: What Our Customers Say
testimonials.description: Thousands of satisfied customers trust MEGA Parking every day.

items.name: Maria Papadopoulou
items.content: Subscribing to MEGA Parking was one of the best decisions I've made. Finding parking in Piraeus is always a challenge, but now I have a dedicated spot that saves me time and reduces my daily stress.

items.name: John Miller
items.content: The corporate parking plan from MEGA Parking has been invaluable for our business. Our clients appreciate the convenience, and our staff no longer waste time looking for parking. The customer service is also exceptional!

items.name: Maria Kostidou
items.content: As a resident living near the port, finding parking was always a nightmare. The monthly subscription with MEGA Parking gives me peace of mind knowing I always have a secure place to park my car. Their facilities are clean, well-lit, and monitored 24/7.
